// row: I2 of docs/tawzee.md §3 — the RPG Maker MV/MZ plugin.
// why tsc: esbuild cannot lower `const`/`let` to `var`: `--target=es5` fails with
'Transforming const to the configured target environment ("es5") is not
supported yet' on every declaration in the file. The source header commits
to ES5 because MV's oldest NW.js is Chromium 41, so the target is not
negotiable and the compiler is what changes.
TypeScript also preserves the leading /*: plugin block that RPG Maker's
Plugin Manager parses, which esbuild would drop as a non-legal comment.
// why this lib set: ES5 plus Promise and nothing else, deliberately. The source header lists
the library functions it must not touch — Map, Set, Symbol, Object.assign,
the grounds that a down-leveller rewrites syntax and polyfills nothing.
Naming the lib is what turns that comment into a compile error.
